findings.claim: The context sheet open flag is stored in the UI store without any route-reset in this diff, so a tablet/phone thread route can render the context sheet already open instead of only opening it from the top-bar toggle.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria 3.2 says the context panel below 1280px opens "as a sheet" from the toggle; design.md decision 5 says `contextSheetOpen` is transient. The diff adds `contextSheetOpen: false` and `setContextSheetOpen` to the persisted `ui-store`, `Topbar` only ever sets it true via `setContextSheetOpen(true)`, and `AppLayout` renders `{!isWide && isThreadView && <ContextPanelSheet />}` without clearing the flag when leaving a thread route.
findings.suggested_fix: Reset `contextSheetOpen` to false when the sheet unmounts or when `pathname`/`isWide` changes away from a sub-1280 thread view, and exclude it from persisted UI state if the store uses Zustand persistence for all serializable fields.
